content: Sonner v2.0.7: Toast library by Emil Kowalski. npm OK verdict, 41M weekly downloads. Install: npm install sonner. Add <Toaster /> to RootLayout. Import toast from sonner. API: toast('message'), toast.success('message'), toast.error('message'), toast.warning (not documented as explicit method but toast with variant param works). All accept {description, duration, action, icon} options. Default position: bottom-right (can override on Toaster). No Radix/shadcn peer deps — standalone. React 18+ compatible.
